node.statement: Compressed-space identity: def-compressed-corner gives S_{P,Q}=Im Co_{P,Q} and S_{P_n,Q_n}=Im Co_{P_n,Q_n}. For every linear T:A->A, Im(iota_n(T)) consists exactly of matrices [T(X_ij)], hence equals M_n tensor Im(T): inclusion from left to right is entrywise, while for [Y_ij] with each Y_ij in Im(T), choose X_ij with T(X_ij)=Y_ij and assemble [X_ij]. Applying this to T=Co_{P,Q} and the preceding compression-map identity yields S_{P_n,Q_n}=M_n tensor S_{P,Q}.
